name: Molecules
description: Biomolecular structure viewer on the display: upload a PDB or mmCIF file and the molecule appears in 3D, ready to explore with your hands.
capabilities: Opens PDB and mmCIF structures of proteins, nucleic acids and ligands, read safely by the Rust engine
Atoms as glowing spheres with no background, bonds computed from distances, backbone for large structures
Colours by element, by chain or by secondary structure (helices and sheets)
Rotate and zoom with mouse, fingers or two hands, and fling it to another screen
